claims.claim: The design specifies principals, delegation ceilings, lifecycle states, ceremony steps, durable intent reconciliation, checkpoints, recovery, monitoring, and portable vector requirements.
Every local/outside council requirement is mapped to a normative design surface and at least one frozen future test.
The design run performed no provider, network, key, hardware, service, or source-implementation operation.
The proposed ceremony is securely implemented or production-ready.
A physical YubiKey/PIV implementation has passed portable vector and device-selection tests.
OS permissions currently prevent models or contractors from writing the authority stores.
